description: SID_SYNC_MODULES chooses the modules that run on /sync, from SID_MODULES. Here SID_MODULES=ip,reflect,geo and SID_SYNC_MODULES=geo,reflect: reflect runs on /sync (uid1 configured with domain example.com, 365 days); geo is listed but runs on /v1 only, so it is reported skipped.

cases.name: runs reflect on /sync and reports geo, which runs on /v1 only, as skipped, in SID_MODULES order
